name: A Watchful Eye
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My rival, Morganth, is a vicious mage of great power who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.  I have developed a means of spying on him, the Eye of Azora, and can now view him from afar.

But to study his thoughts ... I require further aid.

If you are willing, then take my Glyph of Azora to the Tower of Ilgalar.  Place it upon the Lion Statue near the Tower.

When this is done, the power of Azora will grant visions of Morganth's future plans.
narrative.objectives: Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You place the Glyph of Azora on the stone. It adheres itself... and you hear from it Theocritus' disembodied voice:

You have my gratitude, young adventurer. You may now speak with me through this Glyph, and I might have future tasks for you... after I have probed the thoughts of my rival.
narrative.requestItemsText:
This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 21 to 27, 5,300 XP in all.

quests.name: A Watchful Eye
quests.objectiveText: Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.

quests.name: Looking Further
quests.objectiveText: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep. Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.

quests.name: Morganth
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Morganth. Bring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
